item.title: Green Shipping and the Blue Economy
item.description: The International Maritime Organization’s (IMO) net-zero emissions target by 2050 is challenging. item.title: No Reuters global currency reports from United States on Monday, January 19
item.description: There will be no FOREX reports out of the United States on Monday, January 19, due to the Martin Luther King Jr public holiday. Reuters will resume the reports during Asian trading hours on Tuesday January 20. Source: Reuters (Editing by Mark Heinrich)
